release_notes: 1,586 materials with real optical properties - 304 glazing types by tint, coating and thickness, 194 metals by alloy and finish, plus paints, polymers, liquids, stone, ceramics and cloth. The material library is now a searchable browser inside the Materials panel instead of a separate window. The interface has been restructured: seven menus instead of nine, a tool rail down the left that can be moved to any edge, and the measurement input at the bottom left. Adds Reset Panel Layout.
